title: Idol Mahjong: Final Romance R (Kisekae Disc)
native_title: アイドル麻雀 ファイナルロマンスＲ
overview:
The Kisekae Disc is the dress-up companion to Idol Mahjong Final Romance R, the adult strip mahjong game in which you play one-on-one against a cast of idol heroines. It came packed with the game in the Premium Package.

Where the main game only lets you dress up two characters as a bonus after clearing it, this disc opens the dress-up feature for the whole cast, letting you change the outfits of heroines such as Rina Koizumi, Mika Fujisaki, Kate Yamamura, Ryoko Hayami and Asuka Sendo. It is rated for adults only.
